notes.title: Update #11: New game mode!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone![/h3]

As promised in the previous update, we're adding a new game mode for you to enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30300887/9659b7823861d1d0ba23bce8f187faba5922e493.png[/img]

[h2]New game mode: Sandbox[/h2]

In this new mode, you've got infinite money, ammo, and all weapons already equipped for your character. Each in-game day your level resets and you are free to spend 20 skill points any way you like. When you're ready, you can start by selecting any night from 1 to 35.

It should be really useful if you'd like to experiment and test different builds against the wave of your choice or want to do some unconventional challenges for fun. Naturally, you can do so with your friends, as like the other game modes - it supports multiplayer.

The Sandbox mode becomes available as a reward for surviving 14 nights in-game. The achievements and leaderboards are turned off in this mode, so don't worry about triggering something by accident. Just have fun solo or with friends!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30300887/aca2b3985cc8c129be92d9cc234f59920abc26fa.png[/img]

In addition to above, the update also consists of:

- Fix for level-up interface point distribution when joining a game.
- Fix for Leaderboards not opening when using a controller.
- Other minor fixes.

Thank you for all the support you've given us ːghsmileː

[hr][/hr]On a side note, we're working on two new games. One of which is a single-player spin-off to YAZD – [b]Yet Another Zombie Survivors[/b]. It has a [url=steam://install/2265230][b]Steam Demo[/b][/url], which was really popular in the last Steam Next Fest Festival! We plan to launch the game as an Early Access title soon. If you think you might be interested, or want to support us, [b]feel free to [url=steam://install/2265230]check the demo out[/url][/b] and/or wishlist it to help us! Thank you!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2163330/Yet_Another_Zombie_Survivors/[hr][/hr]

notes.title: Update #10: Bug fixes, performance improvements, and unexpected announcements!
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone![/h3]

It's been a long time since Yet Another Zombie Defense HD got an update, but the since the game has reached a new all-time high player count during the current sale, we've decided it deserves some more love! For now, we've pushed a quick update containing the following changes:

[h2]Changes & improvements[/h2]

- The game's engine (Unity) has been upgraded two major versions higher (2017 -> 2019). You might notice that, this isn't the latest engine version available, but it was the newest we could use without breaking too much technical stuff under the hood. Still, the upgrade includes two years' worth of engine bug fixes and optimizations.

- Thanks to the feedback from the recent influx of players from China, we've noticed that in the lobby list, the Asian characters weren't displayed correctly. We've just fixed that.

- In some cases, zombies would group up weirdly at the corners of your bases. That should no longer be the case, as they should distribute nicely along the barricade edges from now on.

- In the previous version, the electro barricade was missing the electric wire. We've rewired it, so now it has its wire back!

- We took the opportunity of the new all-time high player count to showcase our new, upcoming game in the main menu. Guess what? It's also about shooting zombies! If you haven't seen it yet, make sure to check it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2163330/Yet_Another_Zombie_Survivors/?utm_source=yazdhd&utm_campaign=checkournewgame&utm_medium=steam&utm_content=menuvideo
And finally, today's update lays the groundwork for a [b]new game mode we're going to add[/b] in the upcoming weeks. Make sure to follow our social media profiles for more info!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/449009c91e254079de71f592dc506fe8b29b27ac.png[/img] [url=https://twitter.com/AwesomeGamesStd] @AwesomeGamesStd[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/732f76c12c63cfe56093793fc0ca7e90e3589549.png[/img] [url=https://www.facebook.com/AwesomeGamesStudio/] @AwesomeGamesStudio[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/3f7fdc30b8dbd6df988d1c879be43f1adc074d2a.png[/img] [url=https://www.instagram.com/awesomegamesstudio/] @awesomegamesstudio[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25309398/45a4ff463cde0925bab5eff77e2ae81eb3978362.png[/img]  https://discord.gg/m4JfXuS

Have tons of fun playing with your friends & family!
[h3]Awesome Games Studio Team[/h3]

notes.title: Update #9: PERFORMANCE BOOST!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

Easter is over and we hope yours was full of great people, fantastic food and tons of dead zombies! We, on the other hand, took the time to bring some serious performance improvements to our game. We’ve pretty much managed to improve the game’s efficiency in every aspect. This means that, depending on your PC specs, you should be able to notice a double or even triple performance boost! And that’s without any loss in quality of course. Killing zombies is now super smooth. Oh, and we also took the opportunity to kill a few bugs here and there too.

Now, since we know quite a few of you guys are really looking forward to this, we also wanted to let you know that we continue to work on the game and the Workshop thing is not forgotten. We’re currently working on several projects simultaneously, so that’s why updating the Workshop is taking us longer than expected. But the possibility of adding new deadly enemies, guns, levels, barricades and turrets, all created by you, is still there, along with giving you the possibility to play online with all those mods too. We just had to deal with performance issues first.

When is all this happening? You can expect the Workshop improvements to be available within the next couple of weeks. We’re still considering different dates, so bear with us for more details and follow us on Facebook ([url]https://www.facebook.com/AwesomeGamesStudio/[/url]) and Twitter ([url]https://twitter.com/AwesomeGamesStd[/url]) so as not to miss any news.

Until next time!
The Awesome Games Studio Team

Till next time!
Awesome Games Studio team

notes.title: Update #5: Steam Workshop introduction
notes.content:
Hello everyone and apologies for the long wait! It took us a lot more than we thought it would, but we've finally managed to integrate the game with Steam Workshop and the update adding Workshop support is now available.

The Guide on how to make new content for Yet Another Zombie Defense HD can be found here:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1191247929
This is the first Steam Workshop update, but now that we have the game integrated with Workshop we will be able to add new stuff quickly. Currently it supports adding new playable characters into the game, but we plan on adding support for new enemies, guns, levels, barricades and turrets in upcoming days.

Please let us know in the comments what kind of content would you like to be added next! Also, if you're a content creator and you're having any difficulties following the Guide, feel free to shoot an email to contact[at]awesomegamesstudio.com and we'll be happy to assist you!

Additionally, to stay updated on everything we're working on, follow us on facebook and twitter:
https://www.facebook.com/AwesomeGamesStudio/
https://twitter.com/AwesomeGamesStd

The update also enables Razer Chroma support for those who have compatible Razer hardware. If you have any feedback about Chroma animations implemented into the game please let us know!

Once again we apologize for the long delay and we hope that we'll be able to work with you to add as much fresh and fun content into the game as possible.

notes.title: Update #4: Cash sharing options and better stability
notes.content:
Hi everyone,
we've just released an update that makes it possible to choose the way that cash is shared in the team. The host can make a choice to allow client players spend cash up to the amount they earned (default option), can also disable buying by all client players as well as remove any limitations entirely.

We've also significantly improved the game's stability and performance in the later nights. We sincerely apologize for frustration those crashes and game drops caused. It looks that the new version shouldn't crash anymore, but in case this happens please let us know and send the crash log to our email contact[at]awesomegamesstudio[dot]com

notes.title: Update #2: Changes to public games
notes.content:
We've just released an update that enables every player in a public game to buy items and build/remove barricades and mount weapons. However, cash spending is limited to how much a given player has earned during the night and is displayed during the day in parentheses next to team's cash. This limitation doesn't apply to the game's host, he or she can spend all cash that has been collected by all players.

We've also added option for the host to ban people from their game. This option can be accessed from the pause menu.

We also have a status update on Trading Cards - the game is now eligible to have them and as soon they reviewed by Valve everyone will receive them retroactively - if you've already spent enough time in the game to receive the Trading Cards, you'll get them once they are approved by Valve.
